---
title: "How this website handles visitor data"
title-block-banner-color: "#100c08"
---

This website uses [GoatCounter](https://www.goatcounter.com/) for privacy-friendly web analytics.
It collects only aggregate statistics about website usage, such as page views, browser, approximate location, and screen size.

GoatCounter does not use cookies or persistent identifiers, does not store IP addresses, and does not share analytics data with third parties.

You can prevent analytics from being collected by using an ad blocker such as [uBlock Origin](https://ublockorigin.com/).
